rules: 21-day price-position reversion is now covered by the accepted EMA(10)/TS_STD(21) z-score: a 21d high-low stochastic hit rho 0.849 against it and a 5d open-close sum hit 0.876. Push reversion windows well away from 21 days or normalize by something other than trailing range/vol.
Differences of two CS_RANK legs failed the cheap screen three times (|t| 0.08, 0.48, 0.58). Combine legs multiplicatively or conditionally rather than subtracting ranks.

Every fundamental leg tried this round (accrual_gap, roa, book_per_share) died once crossed with a 5-63 day return term (|t| 0.48 to 0.92). Test a fundamental on a slow standalone form before pairing it with price momentum.
Raw 1-5 day return signals failed with both a dollar-volume weight (|t| 0.51) and a value weight (|t| 0.92). Short-horizon reversal only survived when divided by trailing realized volatility.
The only strong accept (4.00) was long-window price structure: position under a 189-day high times 126-day return vol. Spend more of the round in the medium/slow niche with windows over 100 days.
The second fast/price_volume/low accept scored 0.090, so that slot is filled with near-nothing. Aim to displace it, and stop re-deriving path-efficiency / signed-sum-over-abs-sum ratios.
One expression was submitted twice in the same round. Diff each proposal against the round's own proposed list, not just the archive, before submitting.
$dollar_volume appeared once, as a same-day multiplier on $return, and failed. If volume is retried, use it over 60+ day windows as a scaler or conditioner instead.
